desc: Trading Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that effective from August 25, 2026, the Equity Shares of Shankesh Jewellers Ltd (Scrip Code: 544882) are listed and admitted to dealings on the Exchange in the list of ''B'' Group Securities. For further details please refer to the notice no 20260824- dated August 24, 2026.
